title: Introduction to Education (BETA)
description: This book was written to provide students with an introduction to the field of education. The book is broken into chapters that focus on questions students may have about education in general. Although some chapters may go into more depth than others, this is created as an introductory text.
authors: Jennifer Beasley - Author / Myra Haulmark - Author
